sections.name: Arrival and the high bell
sections.action: Carry wool over two low walls, collect a spare, lob at the high bell. There is no water before this required shot.

sections.name: Goon, channel, stone steps
sections.action: Face one goon on flat ground, then cross a 32px channel. A fresh ball and a smaller gap introduce the terrace approach.

sections.name: The visible fork
sections.action: Climb for optional wool and bypass the middle goon, or take the lower combat route and a short channel. Both paths rejoin on safe ground.

sections.name: Broken terraces
sections.action: Cross two wider channels with generous landing ground between them. Steps vary takeoff height; wool rests on the final landing.

sections.name: Last goon and safe bell court
sections.action: Handle the last goon, cross one final channel, enter the closing court and recover its local wool for the low bell shot.

sections.name: Garden exit
sections.action: Cross the table and pass the opened gate. This ends the grove prototype; the banquet level follows in the next milestone.
